name: Institutional Trust
tagline: Measured, accountable and quietly authoritative, like a good annual report
idea: Credibility comes first. A calm split hero leads into a footnoted impact panel and a register that links each principle to its published evidence: methodology, accounts, corrections and safeguarding. Caslon type, navy, ivory and gold rules give the site the poise of an annual report.
fit: Donors, journalists and policymakers need to trust the evidence. Showing how the work is done and funded turns transparency into a reason to give.
informedBy: Impact shown as dated results, apart from news
distinct: The only concept built on proof: every figure is footnoted and every principle links to a published document, like a well-kept register.
buttons: Square-cornered: burgundy to give, navy to read, navy outlines for secondary actions, gold-underlined links.
imageDirection: Few images, each framed by a thin gold keyline or white mat: muted interiors, landscapes and architecture, always captioned.
navigation: Navy utility bar, mega-menu chevrons, breadcrumbs; compact menu on mobile.
visualCharacter: Classical, calm and formal; navy, ivory and gold hairlines
contentEmphasis: Measured impact, governance documents and publications
bestFor: Organisations whose case rests on credibility with donors, institutions, journalists and policymakers
tradeoffs: Less emotional immediacy and campaign energy; the formal tone and dense registers can feel reserved to younger or first-time supporters.
